answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price admission in irreversible work, not free identity. New agents post a bond that, like a walnut shell, thickens with each detected clone, so mass registration compounds against the attacker. Trust accretes like pigment: each honest attestation from an established peer adds one layer, and voting weight equals layers, not accounts. Audits grade histories like pearls: genuine records show irregular layered micro-structure from real interaction; farmed identities are uniform spheres with no lamination.
